thesis_statement: AMD is the credible second-source for AI compute: record revenue driven by EPYC server share and the Instinct GPU ramp, with the Helios rackscale platform and an Anthropic partnership for up to 2 GW of MI450-series deployment opening a multi-year accelerator cycle against NVIDIA's dominance.

base.summary: Data Center growth continues above 50% while Client and Embedded hold, holding non-GAAP EPS near the Q2 annualized run rate.

bull.summary: Helios/MI450 deployments land broadly across the named customers and AMD takes a durable double-digit share of AI accelerator spend.
drivers: Helios deployments cited with Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Oracle and others

bear.summary: AI accelerator competition (NVIDIA cadence, custom silicon) compresses AMD's share, an export-control episode repeats, and the multiple de-rates hard from here.

key_risks: Valuation: trailing P/E ~162 and forward P/E ~40 price in flawless execution.

Export-control repeat risk: the Q2 2025 comparison base included an $800M MI308 inventory charge from U.S. government action, so YoY percentages flatter.
Close is 24.9% above band high; the 09-26 band (confidence 50) predates the post-Q2 rerating and the invalidation level sits far below the market.
